svg.title: Update directions for two pixels under three losses
svg.desc: Three panels, each a square of predicted probabilities for two pixels: the horizontal axis is a foreground pixel, the vertical axis a background pixel, so the correct answer is the bottom-right corner and the confidently wrong answer is the top-left corner. Arrows show the update each loss applies at that point. Cross-entropy: every arrow points towards the bottom-right corner and arrows are longest at the wrong corner. Dice: arrows also point towards the correct corner but shrink to nothing along every edge, so near the wrong corner there is almost no push. Dice with surgery: arrows point to the correct corner with lengths that grow with the error, like cross-entropy, but the foreground component is weighted twice as heavily, as the Dice region terms do at IoU 0.5.
svg.text: almost none at the wrong corner
